name: Learn from a finding, then find the memory on the Memory page
description: SPEC-2026-10-12-memory. From PR #482's Agent runs tab, open the seeded Security Reviewer run and click Learn on its SSRF finding. The modal opens in edit mode with a draft (an LLM draft when a model key is configured, otherwise the deterministic fallback 'title: rationale' — the flow asserts neither text). Saving creates the memory: the card now shows a 'Learned' link, which opens /memory?id=… with that memory preselected in the detail panel. Injection into a later review run is covered by server/test/memory-retrieval.it.test.ts with MockLLMProvider (no model call here). Creates one memory. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB with no memories (e2e-web.yml); run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
